message.text:
**Considering API needs**

I need to explore what APIs are available for all server surfaces. I’m thinking about whether I need frontend, file APIs, or maybe even something like RSS. There’s a lot to consider here! It’s important to have a clear plan, so I should identify the specific agents or tools that can help me with this task. It feels a bit overwhelming, but I’m ready to dive in and figure it all out!

Return one per line: enforcement site — path, with exact lines and rationale. Do not modify.

Here is a complete inventory of **distinct server-side memo view/access enforcement sites** in `/bench/repo`, grouped by surface. Excluded: proto/type conversion (`convertVisibilityFromStore`/`convertVisibilityToStore`), transport auth (`authz.go`, `acl_config.go`), and the embedded SPA (client UI only). MCP (`server/router/mcp/adapter.go`) proxies into the API and adds no separate visibility logic.

---

### API — shared read gate

**`checkMemoReadAccess`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68` — Central per-memo read gate: archived memos only for creator (44-52); non-`PUBLIC` requires auth (55-62); `PRIVATE` denied unless caller is creator (63-65). Used by `GetMemo` (356-369), `ListMemoComments` (148-150).

---

### API — list/query filtering (who may see which memos in bulk)

**`ListMemos` visibility filter** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:188-227` — Query-time enforcement: archived lists empty unless authenticated creator (188-195); anonymous callers restricted to `PUBLIC` (218-219); authenticated callers get `creator_id == self || visibility in [PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` or `VisibilityList` when viewing another user (221-226).

**`ListAllUserStats` visibility filter** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:77-91` — Same visibility rules applied before aggregating memo stats across users.

**`GetUserStats` visibility filter** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:217-220` — Anonymous: `PUBLIC` only; viewing another user: `PUBLIC`+`PROTECTED`; own stats: no extra visibility cap.

**`batchConvertMemoRelations` memoFilter** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:182-206` — When embedding relations in list/get responses, filters related memos: anonymous `visibility == "PUBLIC"` (184), authenticated `creator_id == self || visibility in [PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` (186); applied via `MemoFilter` on `ListMemoRelations` calls (196-206).

**`ListMemoRelations` memoFilter** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:107-131` — Filters both outgoing and incoming related memos with the same anonymous/authenticated visibility expressions (108-112, 116, 130).

**`ListMemoComments` parent gate + comment filter** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148-160` — Parent memo must pass `checkMemoReadAccess` (148-150); comment rows filtered with the same `memoFilter` pattern (156-160, 178).

---

### API — per-handler inline read gates

**`GetMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:356-369` — Enforces via `checkMemoReadAccess` on memo and, for comments, parent memo.

**`ListMemoReactions` visibility check** — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-40` — Non-`PUBLIC` requires auth; `PRIVATE` requires creator or superuser.

**`UpsertMemoReaction` visibility check** — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82-85` — Blocks reacting on `PRIVATE` memos unless creator or superuser (auth required at 61-67).

**`ListMemoAttachments` visibility check** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-224` — Same pattern as reactions: non-`PUBLIC` needs auth; `PRIVATE` needs creator or superuser.

**`CreateMemoComment` visibility check** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33-43` — Blocks commenting on `PRIVATE` memos unless creator or superuser.

**`checkAttachmentAccess`** — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422-455` — Attachment read follows linked memo: `PUBLIC` open (445-446); else auth required (448-449); `PRIVATE` needs creator or superuser (451-452). Called from `GetAttachment` (255-257).

---

### API — share-token alternate read path

**`GetMemoByShare` / `getActiveMemoShare`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:153-207` — Grants memo read without normal visibility checks when share token is valid and unexpired (199-206); archived/missing memos return `NOT_FOUND` (163-166). This is enforcement of *share-based* view access, not visibility enum checks.

---

### API — notification/inbox content filtering (view snippets, not full memo API)

**`canViewerAccessMemo` (notifications API)** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316` — Filters notification payloads: `PRIVATE`→creator only; `PROTECTED`→authenticated; `PUBLIC`→all. Applied when converting comment payloads (337-342) and mention payloads (370, 385).

**`canUserAccessMentionContext` / `shouldSkipMentionInbox`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-88` — Prevents creating mention inbox items for users who could not view the memo/comment context (`PRIVATE` parent/comment checks at 62-68).

---

### SSE (live updates)

**`SSEClient.canReceive`** — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143` — Server-side delivery filter on broadcast: `PRIVATE` events only to creator or admin (136-137); `PUBLIC`/`PROTECTED` to all connected authenticated clients (138-139). `handleSSE` (sse_handler.go:34-44) requires auth but does not itself check memo visibility.

---

### Fileserver (binary attachment serving)

**`checkAttachmentPermission`** — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649-704` — Enforces memo-linked attachment access: unlinked attachments creator/admin only (651-663); `PUBLIC`+anonymous instance allowed (677-678); valid `share_token` for that memo bypasses visibility (684-688); else auth required (691-697); `PRIVATE` needs creator or admin (699-701). Called from `serveAttachmentFile` (149-150).

---

### RSS

**`GetExploreRSS` PUBLIC-only query** — `server/router/rss/rss.go:88-93` — `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]` on `ListMemos`; private/protected memos never enter the explore feed.

**`GetUserRSS` PUBLIC-only query** — `server/router/rss/rss.go:138-143` — Same `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]` filter scoped to a user's memos.

---

### Frontend server (sitemap, not SPA)

**`getSitemapXML` PUBLIC-only query** — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:149-151` — Sitemap lists only `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]` memos; non-public memos excluded from crawlable URLs.

---

### Email notifications

**`canViewerAccessMemo` (email dispatcher)** — `server/notification/email.go:306-320` — Same visibility rules as inbox API; suppresses email bodies when receiver cannot view memo (comment email 155-156, mention email 187-188).

---

### Store / DB (passive query enforcement — applies caller-supplied visibility constraints)

**`ListMemos` `VisibilityList` SQL filter** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:96-103` (mirrored in `store/db/postgres/memo.go:91-95`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:106-110`) — Adds `visibility IN (...)` to SQL when service layer sets `FindMemo.VisibilityList`; enforces at retrieval, not decision-making.

**`ListMemoRelations` `MemoFilter` SQL subquery** — `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:80-93` (mirrored in postgres/mysql `memo_relation.go`) — Compiles visibility filter expression into `memo_id IN (SELECT …)` / `related_memo_id IN (SELECT …)` subqueries, excluding non-visible related memos at the DB layer.

---

### Not enforcement (for clarity)

| Site | Why excluded |
|------|--------------|
| `memo_service_converter.go:44` `convertVisibilityFromStore` | Proto field mapping only |
| `memo_service_comments.go:52` `comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(...)` | Inherits parent visibility on create; not an access check |
| `acl_config.go:32-40` `PublicMethods` | Allows anonymous RPC reachability; memo visibility enforced inside handlers |
| `authz.go:48-68` `CheckAccess` | Instance/procedure authentication, not memo visibility |
| `web/src/*` | Client-side display logic only |

---

**Count: 24 distinct enforcement sites** across API (16), SSE (1), fileserver (1), RSS (2), frontend sitemap (1), email (1), and store SQL (2). The core visibility model everywhere: **`PUBLIC`** → anyone (or anyone on open instance for fileserver); **`PROTECTED`** → authenticated users; **`PRIVATE`** → creator (± admin/superuser depending on site); plus **archived** (creator-only), **share tokens**, and **query-level filtering** for list/aggregate endpoints.
